request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Turn it into a stone-age log submarine: remove the mast, the sail and the feathers; the canoe becomes one closed fat log of the same tawny wood, carved like a plesiosaur, with the blue orange-striped head at the bow and two short carved wooden flippers on its side; on its back a hatch covered with sandy brown hide with big dark brown spots and a bone-white breathing reed standing up. Keep the size, waterline, thick black outline and style, with nothing under the hull.
